entry: Playtest: actual Hub promotion, launch, update and offline workflows on inherited Linux display with isolated synthetic profiles.
recordType: Explicit record of executed checks; no new application playtest this turn. All application/tool fingerprints match this committed source.

environment.java: Oracle JDK 21.0.5 and jpackage bundled runtime
environment.display: Inherited role DISPLAY and XAUTHORITY; no new X server
environment.graphics: LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1, llvmpipe (LLVM 15.0.6, 256 bits), LOW native preset
environment.data: Isolated synthetic profiles under the assigned worktree; loopback publisher/TLS services; browser dispatcher capture

steps: Keep old native and web detail buttons open in the actual Swing Hub.
Promote synthetic catalog A to B, block its fetch, click Play twice, then release the fetch.
Supply malformed catalog metadata, then remove the experience, then disable update checks.
scenarios.expected: Use native source B and web URL B; keep EDT responsive; suppress concurrent Play; retain last verified B on malformed response; refuse removed entries; make no catalog request with updates off.
scenarios.observed: Playtest: open Hub refreshed native A to B and stale web URL to B before Play; EDT responsive during blocked fetch; duplicate Play suppressed; malformed catalog retained verified B; removed entry refused; updates-off made no catalog request; one native download.

steps: Install through Hub Downloads, launch City/Sandbox/editor offline and inspect shared download count.
Present incompatible latest and cached sources.
Supply corrupt update, cancel a transfer and stop the service.
scenarios.expected: Launch compatible clients with one shared download; reject incompatible cached code; preserve verified installation across corrupt updates, cancellation and service loss.
scenarios.observed: Playtest: real hub install, City offline launch, Sandbox and editor offline launch, invalid offline server/port ignored, one shared download, incompatible latest fallback, incompatible cached launch refused, corrupt update fallback, cancel and service-offline verified cache exercised.

steps: Build packaged fixture generations and run the native executable with empty PATH.
Exercise updater faults, locks, migration, JVM scales 1/1.5/2, pinned-TLS login and pre-Play promotion.
Render City, Sandbox and editor; look up installed client after service shutdown.
scenarios.expected: Bundled runtime works; immutable cache retained; UI and launch regressions pass; each native observer records four real frames; offline cache remains usable.
scenarios.observed: Full packaged Linux checker exited 0; all 12 checks passed. Shell movie decoded as 20 frames over 2.917 seconds; each native clip decoded as four frames. Fresh shell, native and removal captures were inspected.

limits: Synthetic promotion and browser dispatch do not prove actual public promotion or published browser gameplay/cached reload.
Two packaged fixture shells do not prove two published shell upgrades.
Software rendering and JVM scaling do not qualify physical GPU gameplay or Windows monitor DPI.
Public catalog/shell/preview delivery returned 404 in the separate delivery check; hosted Windows/macOS reports were still pending at the last inspection.
